title: I can't find the : in the Keyboard manager
author: eltipobuho
summary: Shifted punctuation such as colon and question mark is not clearly available as a Keyboard Manager target.

confidence.rationale: The target gap is confirmed; product semantics between physical keys and characters need confirmation.

judgment.rationale: Multiple missing shifted characters support a focused representation design.
evidence: Colon is absent and the behavior persisted on 0.100.2.
A maintainer linked a second report for question mark.
These characters are key-plus-Shift combinations on common layouts.

fix_assessment.rationale: No concrete existing fix covers the reported path; the lightweight hypothesis is ready for a bounded design workflow.
